thread:
kevin (compliance): Heads-up — we've got three enterprise RFPs asking explicitly for: HSM-backed key storage, immutable audit logs, and configurable retention windows up to 7y. Need to decide what goes into the Q3 roadmap and what is deferred.

ashley (security): Agree we should scope minimal SOC2 control surface first. My suggested priority: 1) Audit log integrity + tamper evidence, 2) KMS/HSM key wrapping for customer-managed keys, 3) Retention UI + policy engine.

pavel (infra): For HSM we estimated ~8 weeks to integrate a cloud HSM provider (bring-your-own or managed) plus key-rotation automation. Cost impact for reserved capacity ~ +15% infra run cost.

maria (product): From GTM — customers expecting this are enterprise prospects; they'd convert at ~3x ARR. But we can't push all three in one quarter, need launch criteria and canary rollout plan.

jonathan (eng): Technical constraints: audit log immutability requires write-once storage + signed append. Option A: use an append-only S3 pattern + object-lock (governance mode). Option B: push logs to external immutable ledger (more dev effort). A is faster.

kevin (compliance): Can we map these to must-have (SOC2/risk) vs nice-to-have (sales ask)? I think audit integrity is must-have for SOC2 scoping; HSM and 7y retention are customer-driven but not strictly SOC2 blockers.

ashley (security): +1. For SOC2 control objectives we need chain-of-custody and proof of tamper detection; implementation: signed entries and retention proof. Not necessarily HSM for SOC2, but HSM satisfies stronger control.

maria (product): Proposal (Q3 roadmap): Sprint 1 (6w): Audit log write pipeline + signed append, S3 object-lock as initial immutable store, basic retention enforcement (configurable per-tenant). Sprint 2 (6w): KMS integration MVP (bring-your-own-key via cloud KMS), key rotation docs. Sprint 3 (stretch): HSM integration + UI for 7y retention policy and exportable attestations.

jonathan (eng): Implementation note — signed append pseudocode for log write:

```
entry = {ts, user, action, meta}
signed = sign(log_signing_key, serialize(entry))
store.append(signed)
```

We need a key hierarchy: signing key (rotated, HSM-backed optionally) and encryption keys if logs are encrypted at rest.

pavel (infra): For long-term retention we need lifecycle rules. 7y per-tenant retention increases S3 cost notably. Suggest default 90d + tiered retention plan (enterprise add-on): 1y, 3y, 7y. We'll include cost estimates in the PRD.

kevin (compliance): Launch criteria checklist idea (short):
- Audit log pipeline writing signed records to immutable store (verified)
- Tamper detection tests + monitoring/alerts
- Per-tenant retention config and enforcement
- Docs for control owners + SOC2 readiness narrative
- Security review + threat model + key management options listed

ashley (security): Add: automated key rotation runbook and proof-of-rotation logs. Also add: integration test that simulates log corruption and demonstrates detection.

maria (product): Questions for negotiation with sales: which customers must have HSM day-one? Can we make HSM an "enterprise add-on" with extra lead time?

kevin (compliance): Yes — propose HSM as premium (Legal/Contract language + lead time). We can commit to audit log integrity + retention tiers as baseline. HSM and 7y retention optional add-ons.

jonathan (eng): Rough dev estimates: audit pipeline + signed store = 4 dev-weeks (1 eng + 0.5 infra), retention config + UI = 2 dev-weeks, KMS BYOK integration = 3 dev-weeks, HSM integration = 6 dev-weeks (more infra orchestration). These are parallelizable partly.

pavel (infra): Ops impact: storage lifecycle policies, egress for exports, and backup verification for long retention. Need approval for additional S3 buckets and cross-account access controls.

audit-bot: [automated scan] control-mapping: audit-logging -> SOC2 CC7, key-management -> SOC2 CC6. No blockers found for proposed baseline.

maria (product): Okay—action items: 1) Security to craft baseline SOC2 narrative and acceptance criteria (ashley + kevin) 2) Eng to commit estimates and a canary rollout plan (jonathan + pavel) 3) Product to prepare PRD + pricing tiers and sales negotiation points (maria). Can we align on a deadline to lock Q3 scope?

kevin (compliance): Let's lock scope by EOD Friday (1762268700) so legal/Sales can update contracts. If anything needs to slide, call it out before then.

ashley (security): I'll drop a short PRD fragment and acceptance tests in this thread by EOD.

jonathan (eng): I'll create a tech spike ticket for the append-only POC and link it here.

pavel (infra): I'll run storage cost calc and post numbers + tiers tomorrow.

maria (product): Thanks — will consolidate PRD and share with sales. :thumbsup:

kevin (compliance): Great. Keeping this thread as the scoping record. If legal needs more detail ping me.

ashley (security): FYI, flagged to our risk board — they want the tamper test added to the staging gate.

jonathan (eng): Noted. I'll include tamper test in CI for the canary environment.

kevin (compliance): Closing: scope-lock target Friday. Thanks everyone. :rocket:"
